author: Rahul Kumar Singh; prepared by ML improvement engineer
registration_event: First git commit containing this protocol and PREREGISTRATION.md; local registration, not an external registry or timestamp.
authorization: Follow-up request to complete more independent campaigns and a separately pre-registered comparison; DEV-20261101-04.

prospective.inconclusive_rule: Fewer than 25 eligible campaigns: INCONCLUSIVE_SAMPLE; counts only, no performance metrics; extension requires new preregistration before further metric access.

development.prior_information: All permitted 2015-2020 development data were opened. Full-development fit has 12 mature rows, 4 positive rows across 2 campaigns. Original folds remain unsupported.

hypotheses.H1: Fixed challenger improves campaign recall over concurrent baseline
hypotheses.H2: Fixed challenger improves mature-alert precision over concurrent baseline
hypotheses.H3: Positive differences for both metrics persist in the explicit-recall-excluded sensitivity slice

primary_metrics.campaign_recall: unique eligible campaign hits / all unique vehicle campaigns in the 2027-2028 campaign window and unchanged scope; unknowns and misses retained
primary_metrics.mature_alert_precision: confirmed full-364-day-follow-up alert episodes / all full-follow-up alert episodes issued in the flag window; confirmation uses outcomes through cutoff

secondary_metrics: uncalibrated score ECE and Brier on all mature candidate rows; 10 equal-width bins; reference prevalence 4/12; descriptive only

features.definition: Same frozen structured_rows count recipe, applied only to 2027-2028 received complaints; completed weeks, 17-week initial support, strict dates before alert availability. No 2026 warm-up, future complaints, recall text, new embeddings or target-derived features.

sample.rule: Count distinct eligible campaign IDs before labels or performance; below 25 return INCONCLUSIVE_SAMPLE with counts only. Keep every eligible campaign, including unknown labels and misses. Do not treat model-year rows as independent campaigns.
sample.independence: Connected components link every alert to every matched campaign in either method, including 2029 precision-only outcomes. Distinct IDs do not prove independent defects. Report the number of eligible-campaign components; below 25 no improvement confirmation.

uncertainty.paired: Resample connected campaign/alert components; retain unmatched alert denominator mass. Precision-only outcome campaigns have zero campaign-recall denominator mass. Check component totals against existing evaluator counts.
uncertainty.invalid_draws: Do not replace invalid draws; CI unavailable below 95% valid draws for that metric.

decision.improvement_confirmed: Both primary paired-difference lower 95% bounds >0 for every seed, and >=25 eligible campaign-linked components.
decision.failure: Either primary point estimate below concurrent baseline.
decision.inconclusive: Insufficient campaigns/components, undefined primary denominators or intervals unable to establish both positive differences.
decision.sensitivity: H3 supported only when both sensitivity paired-difference lower bounds >0 for every seed; otherwise dependence on recall mentions not ruled out.
decision.original_selection: Original Phase 2 failure/Mode B decision remains unchanged. This fixed-challenger research test cannot retroactively satisfy the original selector or authorize promotion.

custody.storage: Human-managed encrypted APFS disk image outside the repository; volume label RCA-PROSPECTIVE
custody.threat_model: Tamper-evident, not access-control. Public NHTSA outcomes can be re-fetched. No-peeking is honor-system; same-account access is not prevented.

collection.schedule: Quarterly preferred; annual minimum in 2027-2028, plus a final outcome snapshot through 2029-12-31. No collection during this task.
collection.shared_cohort: Uses the same 2027-2028 untouched cohort as original Mode B. Separate protocol, not independent replication or extra independent campaigns.
collection.followup: Final snapshot on/after 2029-12-31 plus committed coverage attestation; elapsed time alone does not establish complete source coverage.
collection.classification: Complete pinned-version external classification files required. No paid model calls or imputation by this harness; unavailable model/coverage blocks analysis.

analysis.reruns: No automatic reruns. Failed/partial execution is retained; any change requires a committed deviation and human review before a new analysis.

limitations: Tiny training corpus; challenger may be worse
Recall-confirmed precision is not semantic truth
Public outcomes and same-account custody are honor-system
Campaign IDs may share causes; bootstrap grouping cannot establish full independence
Fixed MY2015-2024 cohort ages during 2027-2028; required sample may not accrue
Historical model labels may incorporate retrospective knowledge
No improvement, production eligibility or promotion is established
